method: Isolated synthetic SQLite databases, localhost-only browser routes, and free local Node checks; no paid model evaluation or participant recruitment.

initialChecks.outcome: An initial nested Playwright locator could not find the exclusion button. The test locator was corrected; no product error or external request was recorded.
Nine flows passed. Visual review then found a previously applied recommendation summary surviving later changes, and an observation document incorrectly labelled as one sheet.

An undefined helper argument, an invalid goal enum, and a convenience-question setup without an available question were corrected in new test fixtures before final reruns. These were not reported as product defects.

productCorrections: Legacy synthetic migration now removes the restore-candidate event together with the fictional skip source.
Allowance lineage excludes question convenience settings and record-only reactions, while actual source, policy, context and selected-candidate eligibility changes still invalidate old authority.
A subsequent successful action or meaningfully changed loaded state clears the previously applied summary; applying a new preview sets its own summary.
The blank observation document is labelled one copy per participant, with multiple print pages permitted. Print CSS inspection is not a PDF pagination or real printer result.
finalEvidence: report.json and its copied browser records contain only the completed final free runs. The main 43-file suite passed 646 checks. One own-public-visibility boundary was added after that suite loaded its test file, with no product source changes; a filtered delta run passed that additional check once. Aggregate unique checks are 647. Earlier failures and pre-fix displays are kept separately.
